frame.lengthCounts: the type byte plus the CBOR body, not the length header itself
frame.transportEncoding: base64 of the whole frame (length header + type + body), one line prefixed F64:

messages.name: HELLO
messages.summary: chip, runtime version/build, flow identity, free flash/RAM, safe mode, hostname, authRequired/authScheme, hasWifi, networkAddress, dependencies

messages.name: DEPLOY
messages.summary: full flow: bytecode, staticData, flowName, deployId, wifiProvision, dependencies

messages.name: DEPLOY_ACK
messages.summary: deploy succeeded, with free-space figures after the new flow started

messages.name: DEPLOY_ERROR
messages.summary: deploy failed: a short code and a message

messages.name: VALUE_STREAM
messages.summary: reserved: live port values (validated on both sides, not emitted yet)

messages.name: NODE_ERROR
messages.summary: node ID plus exception type/message (fault attribution)

messages.name: STATE_READ
messages.summary: reserved: persisted state read (no value key = request, value present = response)

messages.name: STATE_WRITE
messages.summary: reserved: persisted state write

messages.name: TRIGGER
messages.summary: fire one source node's live-trigger event now

messages.name: HELLO_REQUEST
messages.summary: resend the current HELLO without resetting

messages.name: NODE_STATUS
messages.summary: per-node connection/state dot (nodeId, state, optional text)

messages.name: EXEC
messages.summary: run a line of Python in the listener; output comes back as console lines

messages.name: STOP_TO_PROMPT
messages.summary: stop the flow and listener, leaving the board at the REPL prompt

messages.name: SET_BOARD_SETTINGS
messages.summary: save hostname and/or WiFi-transport password (USB serial only)

messages.name: BOARD_SETTINGS_RESULT
messages.summary: answer to SET_BOARD_SETTINGS

messages.name: DEP_PUT
messages.summary: one piece of one file of a library the next flow imports

messages.name: DEP_RESULT
messages.summary: answer to DEP_COMMIT

messages.name: DEP_COMMIT
messages.summary: every piece of a library has been sent; install it

messages.name: RESTART
messages.summary: restart the board (hard=false soft reset, hard=true full chip reset)

messages.name: DEP_ACK
messages.summary: answer to one DEP_PUT piece (paces the sender)
